scope: Bounded web search for Nino Nakano expression and desktop-pet action material; personal fan-art desktop-pet context.
queries: Nino Nakano shimeji desktop pet artist DeviantArt download
中野二乃 shimeji デスクトップ マスコット 配布
decision: No complete Nino pixel Shimeji animation pack matching the existing accepted design was verified during this bounded search. Retain current pixel style, generate eight distinct expressions and four four-phase stationary gestures. Sources below inform pose/expression/context only; no downloaded third-party character pixels enter the application atlas.

candidates.title: Nino Nakano community Codex pet
candidates.source_type: Aggregator listing, not verified author origin
candidates.availability: Public poster fetched successfully; package.zip URL returned HTTP 500 with 40-byte JSON response on this review.
candidates.format: Public 192x208 WebP poster; archive contents and animation count could not be verified.
candidates.observed_content: Poster is a long-haired chibi illustration with green skirt and butterfly ribbons; visibly different from current short-haired low-resolution art.
candidates.reuse_terms: Listing explicitly labels license unknown. An original author page or adaptation grant was not established.

candidates.title: [無料] 中野二乃 {制服,私服} 3Dモデル [五等分の花嫁]
candidates.creator: きりは屋 / uduki-riha
candidates.availability: Free school-uniform and casual downloads listed; no purchase or authenticated download performed.
candidates.format: BLEND, FBX, PNG textures and readme; 26 expression shape keys described by creator.
candidates.observed_content: Multiple face previews; school uniform, blue eyes and black ribbons. Useful expression variety reference, not a ready pixel sprite animation sheet.
candidates.reuse_terms: Creator positions the content for viewing and illustration reference, rather than VRChat use. No broader sprite redistribution license assumed.

candidates.title: Nino Nakano (Chibi), Summer Memories Also Come in Five
candidates.source_type: Game-asset preservation archive; game artwork, not original uploader's fan art
candidates.availability: Public asset page and preview indexed; direct PNG link exposed. Web fetch of that PNG timed out; no archive was downloaded.
candidates.observed_content: Several separate chibi scenes/poses including reading, resting, flowers and eating; not successive frames of a standing desktop-pet gesture.
candidates.reuse_terms: Game and character artwork remains with its rights holders; upload presence is not a new reuse license.

candidates.title: Nakano Nino - KOF Sprite (Pixel Art)
candidates.creator: Rawk-Klark
candidates.availability: Public two-image post, with creator crediting pro_p24 and ProfNote as the underlying long/short-hair illustration references and mentioning DeviantArt/Stash versions.
candidates.format: Two KOF-style pixel figures; no multi-action chibi pack verified.
candidates.observed_content: Long-haired and short-haired variants at fighting-game proportions; incompatible with current chibi frame dimensions and intended quiet gestures.
candidates.reuse_terms: No adaptation/redistribution grant established on opened post.

candidates.title: Nino Nakano by RickyRado
candidates.creator: RickyRado
candidates.format: Single illustration, not an animation pack.
candidates.observed_content: A source with explicit reuse terms but no production multi-frame desktop-pet material.
candidates.reuse_terms: Page states attribution, noncommercial use and share-alike conditions. No pixels used, so the current generated art is not a derivative of this illustration.

candidates.title: Shimeji-ee actions.xml source
candidates.availability: XML content available in indexed source view.
candidates.format: XML action trees referencing numbered PNG poses, explicit anchors, velocities and per-pose durations.
candidates.observed_content: Separate stationary, movement and transition actions; action sequences can be non-looping and use pauses between motions. Informs timing and planted-foot design rather than importing an engine or code.
candidates.reuse_terms: No XML or sprite files copied; concepts only. This note does not claim a character-art license from an engine's source license.

candidates.title: TV anime second-season Nino character page
candidates.format: Character identity and appearance reference, not a sprite pack.
candidates.observed_content: Short pink-haired Nino identity context and characteristic butterfly hair ribbons.
candidates.reuse_terms: Official artwork does not carry an adaptation grant here; identity/context reference only.

downloads_executed: One public poster only, retained as a source-review thumbnail. No external runtime, executable, script, paid pack, browser launch or TTS/GPU process was used.
license_note: Availability and rights are recorded separately. Unknown license is not described as free/open licensing. No third-party sprite pixels were redistributed in the generated atlas.
